def batch_word_ref
  (u : Std.U32) (tree : Std.Usize) (j : Std.Usize) : Result Std.U64 := do
  let index ← if tree = 2#usize
                then u / 4#u32
                else ok u
  let i ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from index)
  let i1 ← i * 256#u64
  let i2 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 j)
  i1 + i2

def batch_init_ref : Result (Array Std.U64 16#usize) := do

    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 26:112-26:174
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def batch_keys_ref_loop.body
  (queries : Array Std.U32 22#usize) (lo : Std.Usize) (n : Std.Usize)
  (tree : Std.Usize) (keys : Array Std.U64 16#usize) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U64 16#usize) × Std.Usize) (Array Std.U64
    16#usize))
  := do
  if j < n
  then
    let i ← lo + j
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize queries i
    let i2 ← batch_word_ref i1 tree j
    let keys1 ← Array.update keys j i2
    let j1 ← j + 1#usize
    ok (cont (keys1, j1))
  else ok (done keys)

@[rust_loop]
def batch_keys_ref_loop
  (queries : Array Std.U32 22#usize) (lo : Std.Usize) (n : Std.Usize)
  (tree : Std.Usize) (keys : Array Std.U64 16#usize) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U64 16#usize)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (keys1, j1) => batch_keys_ref_loop.body queries lo n tree keys1 j1)
    (keys, j)

/-- [ndf_reference::batch_keys_ref]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 26:0-26:179
    Visibility: public -/
def batch_keys_ref
  (queries : Array Std.U32 22#usize) (lo : Std.Usize) (n : Std.Usize)
  (tree : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U64 16#usize)
  := do

  batch_keys_ref_loop queries lo n tree keys 0#usize

import NDI_BatchRef.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDI_BatchWord
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem word (u : U32) (tree coordinate : Usize) (bound : coordinate.val<16) :
    ∃ out, NDI_BatchRef.batch_word_ref u tree coordinate=ok out ∧
      out.val=256*(if tree=2#usize then u.val/4 else u.val)+coordinate.val := by
  obtain ⟨index,div,indexVal⟩ := UScalar.div_spec (x:=u) (y:=4#u32) (by decide)
  have widen (x : U32) : (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x).val=x.val := by
    change (x.bv.setWidth 64).toNat=x.bv.toNat
    exact BitVec.toNat_setWidth_of_le (by decide)
  have wi := widen index
  have wu := widen u
  by_cases tag : tree=2#usize
  · have b := index.hmax
    obtain ⟨product,mul,pval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (U64.mul_spec (x:=core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from index) (y:=256#u64) (by scalar_tac))
    obtain ⟨out,add,oval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (U64.add_spec (x:=product) (y:=UScalar.cast .U64 coordinate) (by scalar_tac))
    refine ⟨out,?_,?_⟩
    · simp only [NDI_BatchRef.batch_word_ref,if_pos tag,div,bind_tc_ok,
        lift,mul,bind_tc_ok,add]
    · simp only [tag,if_true] ; scalar_tac
  · have b := u.hmax
    obtain ⟨product,mul,pval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (U64.mul_spec (x:=core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from u) (y:=256#u64) (by scalar_tac))
    obtain ⟨out,add,oval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (U64.add_spec (x:=product) (y:=UScalar.cast .U64 coordinate) (by scalar_tac))
    refine ⟨out,?_,?_⟩
    · simp only [NDI_BatchRef.batch_word_ref,if_neg tag,bind_tc_ok,
        lift,mul,bind_tc_ok,add]
    · simp only [tag,if_false] ; scalar_tac

#print axioms word
end NDI_BatchWord

NDI_BatchStep.content:
import NDI_BatchWord
import NBE_KeyLoop
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDI_BatchStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow

theorem step (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (lo n tree j : Usize) (keys : Array U64 16#usize)
    (size : n.val≤16) (fit : lo.val+n.val≤22) (active : j.val<n.val) :
    ∃ next value, next.val=j.val+1 ∧
      value.val=256*(if tree=2#usize then queries.val[lo.val+j.val]!.val/4
        else queries.val[lo.val+j.val]!.val)+j.val ∧
      NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref_loop.body queries lo n tree keys j =
        ok (cont (keys.set j value,next)) := by
  obtain ⟨address,add,addressVal⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.add_spec (x:=lo) (y:=j) (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨u,read,uval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec queries address (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨value,word,valueVal⟩ := NDI_BatchWord.word u tree j (by omega)
  obtain ⟨changed,write,changedEq⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec keys j value (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨next,inc,nextVal⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.add_spec (x:=j) (y:=1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
  have room : lo.val+j.val<queries.val.length := by have length : queries.val.length=22 := queries.property;omega
  have ue : u=queries.val[lo.val+j.val]! := by
    simpa only [addressVal,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem room,Option.getD_some] using uval
  refine ⟨next,value,nextVal,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [ue] using valueVal
  · have h : j<n := active
    simp only [NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref_loop.body,if_pos h,add,read,word,write,inc,
      changedEq,bind_tc_ok]

theorem done_step (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (lo n tree j : Usize) (keys : Array U64 16#usize)
    (terminal : n.val≤j.val) :
    NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref_loop.body queries lo n tree keys j=ok (done keys) := by
  have h : ¬j<n := by scalar_tac
  simp only [NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref_loop.body,if_neg h]

theorem frame (keys : Array U64 16#usize) (j : Usize) (value : U64) (k : Nat) (bound : k<16) :
    (keys.set j value).val[k]! =(if k=j.val then value else keys.val[k]!) := by
  have len := keys.property
  simp only [Array.set,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_set]
  by_cases hit : k=j.val <;> simp_all

#print axioms step
#print axioms done_step
#print axioms frame
end NDI_BatchStep

NDI_BatchRun.content:
import NDI_BatchStep
import NBI_Keys
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDI_BatchRun
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1

theorem frame_all (keys : Array U64 16#usize) (j : Usize) (value : U64)
    (active : j.val<16) (k : Nat) :
    (keys.set j value).val[k]! =(if k=j.val then value else keys.val[k]!) := by
  by_cases bound : k<16
  · exact NDI_BatchStep.frame keys j value k bound
  · have len : (keys.set j value).val.length=16 := (keys.set j value).property
    have oldLen : keys.val.length=16 := keys.property
    have distinct : k≠j.val := by omega
    simp only [if_neg distinct,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : (keys.set j value).val.length≤k),
      List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : keys.val.length≤k)]

theorem run (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (lo n tree j : Usize) (keys : Array U64 16#usize)
    (word : Nat → U64) (size : n.val≤16) (fit : lo.val+n.val≤22) (bound : j.val≤n.val)
    (spec : ∀ k, k<n.val → (word k).val=
      256*(if tree=2#usize then queries.val[lo.val+k]!.val/4
        else queries.val[lo.val+k]!.val)+k) :
    ∃ final, NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref_loop queries lo n tree keys j=ok final ∧
      ∀ k, final.val[k]! =NBE_KeyLoop.fill word (n.val-j.val) j.val (fun c=>keys.val[c]!) k := by
  by_cases active : j.val<n.val
  · obtain ⟨next,value,nextVal,valueVal,body⟩ := NDI_BatchStep.step queries lo n tree j keys size fit active
    have eq : value=word j.val := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (valueVal.trans (spec j.val active).symm)
    subst value
    obtain ⟨final,tail,cells⟩ := run queries lo n tree next (keys.set j (word j.val)) word size fit (by omega) spec
    refine ⟨final,?_,?_⟩
    · unfold NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref_loop
      conv_lhs => unfold loop
      simpa only [body,NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref_loop] using tail
    · intro k
      rw [cells k,show n.val-j.val=(n.val-next.val)+1 by omega,NBE_KeyLoop.fill]
      simp only [nextVal]
      congr 1
      funext c
      exact frame_all keys j (word j.val) (by omega) c
  · have last : j.val=n.val := by omega
    refine ⟨keys,?_,?_⟩
    · unfold NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref_loop
      conv_lhs => unfold loop
      simp only [NDI_BatchStep.done_step queries lo n tree j keys (by omega)]
    · intro k
      simp only [last,Nat.sub_self,NBE_KeyLoop.fill]
termination_by n.val-j.val

#print axioms frame_all
#print axioms run
end NDI_BatchRun

NDI_BatchBridge.content:
import NDI_BatchRun
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NDI_BatchBridge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1

theorem reference (raw : Array U32 22#usize) (lo n tree : Usize) (batch : Nat)
    (lower : lo.val=(if batch=0 then 0 else 10))
    (count : n.val=(if batch=0 then 10 else 12))
    (canonical : ∀ k, k<22 → raw.val[k]!.val<262144) :
    NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref raw lo n tree =
      ok (Port4B_KeyInstall.keyArray raw batch tree.val) := by
  let word := fun j => MultiproofConeSortOrder.packed (Port4B_KeyInstall.queries raw)
    batch tree.val ((if batch=0 then 0 else 10)+j)
  have size : n.val≤16 := by rw [count];split <;> omega
  have fit : lo.val+n.val≤22 := by rw [lower,count];split <;> omega
  have tag : (tree=2#usize) ↔ tree.val=2 := by
    constructor
    · intro h;subst tree;rfl
    · intro h;exact UScalar.eq_of_val_eq h
  have spec : ∀ k, k<n.val → (word k).val=
      256*(if tree=2#usize then raw.val[lo.val+k]!.val/4
        else raw.val[lo.val+k]!.val)+k := by
    intro k active
    have bound : (if batch=0 then 0 else 10)+k<22 := by omega
    have h := NBI_Keys.packed_word raw batch tree.val k (by omega) (canonical _ bound)
    simpa only [word,lower,tag] using h
  obtain ⟨out,call,cells⟩ := NDI_BatchRun.run raw lo n tree 0#usize
    (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u64) word size fit (by simp) spec
  have equal : out=Port4B_KeyInstall.keyArray raw batch tree.val := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · exact out.property.trans (Port4B_KeyInstall.keyArray raw batch tree.val).property.symm
    · intro k ha hb
      have kb : k<16 := by have length : out.val.length=16 := out.property;omega
      have h := cells k
      have init : (fun c : Nat => (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u64).val[c]!) = (fun _ => 0#u64) := by
        funext c
        simp only [Array.repeat,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_replicate]
        split <;> rfl
      rw [init] at h
      have old := NBI_Keys.key_array_values raw batch tree.val k kb
      change out.val[k]! =NBE_KeyLoop.fill word n.val 0 (fun _ => 0#u64) k at h
      rw [count] at h
      simpa only [word,
        List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem hb,Option.getD_some] using h.trans old
  simp only [NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref,call, equal]

#print axioms reference
end NDI_BatchBridge

NDI_BatchCaller.content:
import NDI_BatchBridge
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDI_BatchCaller
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2

theorem canonical (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (pm : OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.Prepared)
    (am : QueryAccumulator.State OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.K OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.E)
    (fields : CheckpointBytes4SavedFields.BodyMatches p a pm am) :
    ∀ k, k<22 → p.queries.val[k]!.val<262144 := by
  intro k bound
  have len : p.queries.val.length=22 := p.queries.property
  have cell := congrArg (fun xs : List Nat => xs[k]!) fields.queries
  simp only [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_map,
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega : k<p.queries.val.length),Option.map_some,
    Option.getD_some,List.getElem?_ofFn,bound,↓reduceDIte] at cell
  have value : p.queries.val[k]!.val=(pm.queries ⟨k,bound⟩).val := by
    simpa only [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega : k<p.queries.val.length),Option.getD_some] using cell
  rw [value]
  exact (pm.queries ⟨k,bound⟩).isLt

#print axioms canonical
end NDI_BatchCaller

NDI_BatchControl.content:
import NDI_BatchRef.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDI_BatchControl
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem initial : NDI_BatchRef.batch_init_ref=ok (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u64) := rfl

theorem active (start finish : Usize) (room : start.val<finish.val) (cap : finish.val≤16) :
    ∃ next, next.val=start.val+1 ∧
      NDI_BatchRef.range_ref start finish=ok (true,start,next,finish) := by
  obtain ⟨next,inc,nextVal⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.add_spec (x:=start) (y:=1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
  refine ⟨next,nextVal,?_⟩
  have h : start<finish := room
  simp only [NDI_BatchRef.range_ref,if_pos h,inc,bind_tc_ok]

theorem done (finish : Usize) :
    NDI_BatchRef.range_ref finish finish=ok (false,0#usize,finish,finish) := by
  simp only [NDI_BatchRef.range_ref,lt_self_iff_false,if_false]

theorem reached (lo n tree : Nat) (split : (lo=0 ∧ n=10) ∨ (lo=10 ∧ n=12))
    (kind : tree<3) (j : Nat) (more : j<n) :
    lo≤22 ∧ n≤16 ∧ lo+n≤22 ∧ j<n ∧ tree<3 ∧ lo+j<22 ∧ j<16 := by
  rcases split with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩ <;> omega

#print axioms initial
#print axioms active
#print axioms done
#print axioms reached
end NDI_BatchControl

NDI_BatchInstalled.content:
import NDI_BatchCaller
import NDI_BatchControl
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDI_BatchInstalled
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1

theorem installed (raw : Array U32 22#usize) (lo n tree : Usize)
    (split : (lo=0#usize ∧ n=10#usize) ∨ (lo=10#usize ∧ n=12#usize))
    (kind : tree.val<3) (canonical : ∀ k, k<22 → raw.val[k]!.val<262144) :
    NDI_BatchRef.batch_keys_ref raw lo n tree=Port4B_KeyInstall.build raw lo n tree := by
  rcases split with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  · rw [NDI_BatchBridge.reference raw 0#usize 10#usize tree 0 rfl rfl canonical]
    simp [Port4B_KeyInstall.build,OraclePortSelectedDraft.batchPositions,kind]
  · rw [NDI_BatchBridge.reference raw 10#usize 12#usize tree 1 rfl rfl canonical]
    simp [Port4B_KeyInstall.build,OraclePortSelectedDraft.batchPositions,kind]

#print axioms installed
end NDI_BatchInstalled
